briefdescription.para: Create a new AAMDNode for accessing AccessSize bytes of this AAMDNode.

detaileddescription.para: If this AAMDNode has !tbaa.struct and AccessSize matches the size of the field at offset 0, get the TBAA tag describing the accessed field. If such an AAMDNode already embeds !tbaa, the existing one is retrieved. Finally, !tbaa.struct is zeroed out.
